# @0xray/grok-bot

> Complete setup path for Grok Bot agents on the 0xRay mill: suits (one per agent), Groover identity, OWS pay, hangar shops, and the NEAR path (foundry, pay, cap, escrow).

## Start
This kit runs on Node >= 24. The `0xray` package needs Node >= 24.22.3, the patched 24 release from 11 Nov 2026.

0. A new fleet runs `skills/stand-up-fleet/SKILL.md` once: house, routes, then one suit per seat. It does not start the Bifrost server. The NEAR path is foundry, pay, cap, escrow, the Grok Bot one-click, and the CLI. The kit commands are `foundry-create`, `near-status`, `near-pay`, `near-cap`, `near-escrow`, `near-1click`, `near-mailbox`, and `hangar-list`. They stay on NEAR testnet. The one-click runs `foundry-create` and `near-status` only. Open Wallet pay and hangar shops still wait until the owner asks.
1. Read `OP-PROC.md` first (the one-page operating procedure).
2. Board: `house/WAVEBOARD.md` and `house/ATTENTION_STATE.md` when `LIVE_URL` is unset. Bifrost cards (`GET /cards`) and `house/ATTENTION_STATE.md` when `LIVE_URL` is set. If a file is missing, use the same name under `templates/house/`.
3. Read `AGENTS.md` (order of operations + multiplicity).
4. Open `SKILLS.md` and run skills in order for **each** key agent. Each new seat runs `seat-label` in its own chat.
5. No `house/` yet: `npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 house init` (skill `setup-house`). It copies `templates/house/`, including `watchers/` and `fleet/`, and refuses to overwrite. `house init --migrate` moves `ops/WAVEBOARD.md` to `house/WAVEBOARD.md`, appends `## Cadence` when `HOUSE.md` lacks it, and starts missing watcher and fleet files. When both boards exist and `house/WAVEBOARD.md` is not the untouched template, migrate exits 1 and writes nothing. It does not overwrite a ledger. Doctor uses `GROK_BOT_HOUSE` if set, otherwise walks up for `house/HOUSE.md`. With a Cadence section, doctor warns when a watcher log or `stall-sweep.log` is older than 2 hours, when the activity log's last line lacks `t_ct`, `kind`, `action`, and `seat`, or when the suit codex term count differs from `node_modules/0xray`.
6. Cadence defaults: https://github.com/0xRayAI/xray/blob/main/grok-bot/CADENCE.md#seat-loop — delete `## Cadence` if the house has no code loop. Watchers: `house/watchers/merge-queue.md`, `review-sent.log`, `stall-sweep.log`, `issue-sweep-last.txt`, `waveboard-static.md`. Fleet log: `house/fleet/activity.jsonl`. An owner prompt is `live-inbox <seat> --prompt`, which posts to `/activity`.
7. After a long chat or before coding: `skills/survive-compact/SKILL.md` — read disk, resume the live cloud, do not rebuild.

## Install
```bash
npm i @0xray/grok-bot
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 doctor    # first line names the kit and 0xray; prove mill+inspect; house off omits Board; a foreign bridge is WARN
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 ready     # alias
npx --no-install grok-bot live-inbox <seat> --prompt --from owner --note "<gist>"   # board tool; needs python3, LIVE_URL, SEAT_KEYS_DIR
npx --no-install grok-bot exit-gate .xray/state/NOTES.md --git   # wake step 7 gate
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 foundry-create --id <id> --seat <seat> --account <new-name>.testnet
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 near-status
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 near-pay --receiver <account> --amount <u128> --nonce <nonce> --signer <account> --key <cold.json>
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 near-cap init|allow|deny|add-agent-key
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 near-escrow init|open|fund|deliver|accept|refund
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 near-1click init --ledger <file>
npx @0xray/grok-bot@0.1.19 near-mailbox post|claim|submit|accept|refund|release|jobs
```

## Live product URLs (plant)
- Factory /suit UI: https://website-production-c0da.up.railway.app/suit
- Registry MCP: https://registry-production-e2c4.up.railway.app/mcp
- Hangar shops (Clearing): https://clearing-production-9968.up.railway.app/
- Board: each fleet deploys its own Bifrost (skill `stand-up-fleet`). https://bifrost.0xray.dev is the 0xRay fleet's own board, not a choice for a new fleet.
- Docs: https://docs.0xray.dev/
- OS docs: https://github.com/0xRayAI/xray/tree/main/grok-bot

## Depends on (do not vendor)
- `0xray` — fasten mill+inspect (`npx 0xray wear`, then `npx 0xray validate`)
- Groover registry — register / mint / pin
- `groover-hangar` — plant shops
- Open Wallet (OWS) — local pay on Base USDC
- Board: `house/` first, else `templates/house/`
